Looking for a long-term logistics job in a high-tech environment? For a modern high-tech company in Son, we are looking for a Logistics Employee who enjoys active work, likes structure and is comfortable working in a 2-shift schedule. Previous warehouse experience is welcome, but not always required. If you come from production or another hands-on environment and are motivated to learn logistics, we would also like to hear from you. You will work in an international logistics team and earn between €3,300 and €3,400 gross per month, including 14.4% shift allowance. What’s your job about? As a Logistics Employee, you will work in a team of around 10 to 15 colleagues. Together, you make sure incoming and outgoing goods are processed correctly and efficiently. Your tasks may include: receiving and checking incoming goods; picking and preparing production orders; packing and preparing shipments; processing goods in the warehouse system; moving materials using an EPT or reach truck; checking quantities and quality; keeping the warehouse clean and safe. The work is physically active. You will spend a lot of time walking and standing, and you may lift items up to 25 kg several times per day. Lifting equipment is available for heavier or more difficult loads. Working hours You work in a 2-shift schedule: Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:15 Afternoon shift: 14:15 – 23:00 On Fridays during the late-shift week, you usually finish around 20:30 What skills do you have? You: speak English well enough to understand instructions and communicate with colleagues; are available for both shifts; are physically fit and comfortable with a lot of walking and standing; can lift up to 25 kg when required; work accurately and safely; are motivated and willing to learn; can arrange your own transport to Son. Previous logistics experience is a plus, but not a hard requirement. Experience in production or another hands-on working environment can also be relevant. What do you get in return? You canexpect: €3,300 – €3,400 gross per month, including 14.4% shift allowance; €0.23 per kilometre travel allowance; 25 vacation days + 13 ADV days, already financially included in the salary; STIPP pension; a long-term position; possibility of being taken over by the client after 1,040 hours, approximately 6 months full-time; possibility to obtain an EPT or reach truck certificate through Wiertz Company or the client; working in an international high-tech logistics environment; a close-knit team of 10–15 colleagues. You will work for a modern high-tech company in Son, where advanced technology and efficient logistics come together. The logistics department consists of several teams working in shifts. You will mainly work with your own logistics colleagues and focus on making sure goods and materials are available at the right place and time.

We are looking for an experienced Project Lead Logistics to lead complex improvement projects within a high-tech logistics and operations environment. In this role, you will combine project management expertise with logistics engineering knowledge to design, implement, and standardize sustainable solutions in a dynamic logistics environment. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to optimize logistics processes, improve operational performance, and support the implementation of innovative warehouse solutions. Wie zoeken we? To be successful in this role, you will have a strong background in logistics project management, logistics engineering, and continuous improvement. Requirements: At least five years of experience as a Project Lead in a logistics or warehouse environment. A proven track record of successfully delivering logistics improvement projects from initiation through implementation and handover. Experience in logistics engineering and the design and implementation of logistics processes and warehouse solutions. A bachelor's or master's degree in Business Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field. A recognized project management certification, such as Lean, Six Sigma, PRINCE2, or an equivalent qualification. Experience with Lean methodologies and change management. Strong project leadership, analytical, and decision-making skills. Experience managing project scope, planning, resources, risks, stakeholders, and deliverables. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, results-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively under pressure. Professional proficiency in English. Willingness and ability to meet the required security screening requirements, including obtaining a Certificate of No Objection (VGB). Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP EWM. Experience with ASRS and warehouautomation solutions. Experience conducting MTM (Methods-Time Measurement) studies. Wat bieden wij je? Salary: Negotiable, depending on experience, qualifications, and expertise. Working hours: 40 hours per week. Working schedule: Day shift. Working location: High-tech logistics environment in the Venlo/Eindhoven region. On-site presence: Primarily on-site, with approximately four days per week in the office and limited opportunities to work from home. Contract duration: Initial assignment of 12 months, with the possibility of an extension up to 24 months, depending on performance and business needs. Additional allowances: Stand-by and overtime allowances apply. Training and development: Access to additional training and professional development opportunities. Work environment: A dynamic, high-tech logistics environment, including occasional work in a cleanroom, where a cleanroom suit must be worn. Pre-employment screening: Enhanced screening is required, including the necessary VGB clearance. Functieomschrijving As a Project Lead Logistics, you will be responsible for managing logistics improvement projects from initiation through implementation and final handover. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Logistics Operations and related departments to deliver measurable and sustainable results. Your responsibilities will include: Lead logistics improvement projects from initiation to implementation and handover. Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships. Optimize and standardize logistics processes, systems, and warehouse solutions. Manage project scope, planning, resources, risks, and deliverables. Analyze operations and implement measurable improvements using Lean methodologies. Support SAP EWM and warehouse automation projects, including ASRS. Monitor project progress and ensure alignment with business objectives. You will report to the Group Lead Logistics Projects within Logistics Operations.
